lede: Interior Secretary Douglas J. Burgum disclosed five new trades, the largest a purchase of Nucleus Security, Inc. through Arthur Ventures Growth IV, LP valued at up to $250,000, dated April 8, 2026. The remaining transactions, all also dated April 8, involved purchases and one sale of holdings tied to several Arthur Ventures funds, each ranging from $1,001 to $15,000. Across all filings tracked by Open Cabinet, Burgum has reported 148 transactions, 104 of which were flagged as filed late under the filer's own certification.
